images.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: single-frame rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, action 076 T-LOW-009 s01, plain studio photo with no words.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and identity / style / composition reference. Produce one new edited photograph, not a collage.
Primary request: Change ONLY the upper leg from the currently open clamshell to the closed starting position: the woman lies steadily on her side, both hips and knees comfortably bent, the upper knee gently resting directly on the lower knee, BOTH feet continuing to touch one another exactly where they are in the original. Lower leg remains fully supported on the mat. Show two natural overlapping bent legs with realistic knees, shins, ankles and feet, not a straightened leg.
Keep unchanged: this exact same woman's face, hair and body proportions, white short-sleeve shirt, charcoal gray trousers, white socks, full-body framing, head and neck supported on the small gray pillow, lower arm tucked naturally beneath pillow, top hand resting on mat in front of torso, neutral steady side-lying torso and pelvis with no backward roll, gray non-slip mat, gray-blue studio background and floor, camera angle, distances, exposure and soft light. Head, hands, all knees and both complete feet must stay in frame. Preserve the blank space and portrait canvas composition.
No resistance band, no weights, no extra equipment, no motion arrows, no text, no logos, no watermark. Do not change the room, pillow, mat, body orientation or camera framing. Only close the upper knee to make the clamshell starting posture.

visual_review.findings: 稳定侧卧，头颈由小枕承托，双膝舒适屈曲合拢、双足接触，底腿落垫；骨盆和躯干稳定，身体比例与关键关节自然，无文字、箭头、弹力带或新增器材。

images.group_review: passed；由 s02 原图仅编辑上侧腿闭膝，人物、机位、器材、背景和尺度连续。
